policy: Two shared ordinary black-border red profiles. Fourth Edition selected by calibration-only boundaries and independent texture diagnostics; reserved names evaluate it. Qualified original-wording references only; the two rejected scans are rendered but never score or fit. This is regional source/color work, not complete-set or whole-card certification.
limitations: Atog f77fda65 and Ball Lightning retain rejected scan poses. Shared renderer profiles apply, but neither contributes measurements.
Headings, mana/expansion symbols, artist and stats still need calibration for these red sources. Current glyph/layout output is preserved.
Stock bounds retain the earlier set-level target; corners and outer-stock certification remain open.
Existing hosted review templates and full-card score revisions have not been updated by this source/color receipt.
